claim: HPA cell-type-resolved normal-tissue IHC (109 tissue/cell-type rows for CEACAM5) is High only in Appendix/Colon/Rectum enterocytes (incl. microvilli), endocrine cells and goblet cells (12 rows), and Medium only in mucosal lymphoid cells (Colon/Rectum), squamous epithelial cells (Esophagus/Oral mucosa), and glandular cells (Stomach) (6 rows). Every other scored cell type, including lung alveolar cells type I and type II (both Low), bone marrow hematopoietic cells (Low), tonsil and smooth muscle (not scored High/Medium anywhere), is Low or Not detected. This does not corroborate TE001's flagged lung/tonsil/smooth-muscle RNA signal at High/Medium protein level in the scored cell types, which lowers -- but does not eliminate -- the normal-tissue concern: HPA's cell-type panel is not exhaustive, and a Low IHC score is not zero accessible surface antigen.
structured_value: High(12 rows)=Appendix/Colon/Rectum:{enterocytes,enterocytes-Microvilli,endocrine cells,goblet cells};Medium(6 rows)=Colon/Rectum:mucosal lymphoid cells,Esophagus/Oral mucosa:squamous epithelial cells,Stomach:glandular cells;Low_or_NotDetected=91 rows incl. notes: This is Module E's core protein/IHC-first triage evidence (not the RNA-only screen TE001/TE002 are), per module README. evidence_directness=UNCALIBRATED_PROXY, not CALIBRATED_PROXY -- there is no target-specific quantitative surface assay, flow-cytometry antigen-density calibration, or IHC-to-surface-density mapping backing this row; IHC is closer to real biology than bulk RNA but is not itself a calibration step. IHC intensity is not a quantitative surface-density assay and cannot by itself establish accessible antigen density or a therapeutic window (see module README Cannot-prove section). Mucosal lymphoid cells at Medium are immune infiltrate, not epithelium -- read as a distinct finding, not folded into the epithelial pattern.

claim: Attempted arm-level CNV-lite malignancy confirmation on GSE178318's treated-cohort (COL15/COL17/COL18) epithelial-proxy cells (per TE004), scored against a held-out half of a treated-cohort tumor-site-immune reference (both populations restricted to the same 3 patients as TE004's indication_id). Epithelial-proxy cells show a modest median CNV-score shift vs. the held-out reference (1.32 vs 0.63, ~2.1x) -- directionally consistent with malignant signal -- but the distributions overlap substantially; 36/1,786 (2.02%) of epithelial-proxy cells clear the threshold (99th percentile of the held-out reference half) vs. 190/19,002 (1.00%) of the held-out reference's own cells (enrichment ratio 2.02x). Per-sample CNV_HIGH counts are mostly single-digit (0-22 cells) for a reliable prevalence estimate. Best described as an observed CNV-like score shift with an ambiguous, nonconfirmatory signal -- not attributable with this method to CNV vs. lineage-driven expression differences (epithelial vs immune) vs. resolution loss, treated as co-equal, un-excluded explanations.
notes: This does NOT confirm malignancy at the single-cell level and does NOT supersede or strengthen TE004/TE005 (the epithelial-proxy screen) -- TE004/TE005 remain Module B's primary evidence for this target. Recorded as its own honestly-characterized attempt: an observed, modest, population-level CNV-like score shift, directionally consistent with malignancy but ambiguous and nonconfirmatory at the single-cell level. This coarse arm-level method lacks within-cell gene-order smoothing and a centering/reference-subtraction step (not primarily "no cross-cell smoothing"), and its mean(z^2) aggregate erases gain/loss direction; lineage-driven expression differences (epithelial vs immune, unrelated to copy number) are an equally plausible, co-equal alternative explanation for the shift, not a secondary caveat. Reference and epithelial-proxy populations are restricted to the 3 treated patients (COL15/COL17/COL18), matching TE004's indication_id=mcrc_preop_chemotherapy_crlm -- a round-3 fix (PR #75 round-2 review) after an earlier version pooled all 6 GSE178318 patients (82% treatment-naive) under this treated-cohort row; the pooled-population numbers are kept only as a method diagnostic in the analysis contract. Module B's actual malignant-cell prevalence question for tgt_ceacam5 remains open.
